segments.text:
Moreover, in this example of Iudas you may read this truth; That men and women are never in more eminent danger, than when they meet with temptations exactly suited to their master-lusts; to their own iniquity. O pray, pray, that ye may be kept
from a violent suitable temptation. Satan knows that when a man is tried here, he falls by the root. The love of this world was all along Iudas his master-sin, and some conjecture he was a married man, and had a great charge; but that is conjectural, it was his predominant Lust. The Devil found out this, and suited it with a temptation, which fully hit his humour, and it carries him immediately. This is the dangerous Crisis of the soul. Now you shall see what it is, and what it will do. Put mony before Iudas, and presently you shall see what the man is.
